title: EarlyTom Early Token Compression Completes Fast Video Understanding
one_line: Early token compression in vision encoder for faster video understanding
innovations: Inner vision encoder frame merging strategy
method_framework: EarlyTom performs early-stage token compression inside vision encoder via frame merging and spatial selection, reducing TTFT by 2.65x while maintaining accuracy.
experiment_framework: Evaluated on LLaVA-OneVision-0.5B/7B across MVBench, EgoSchema, LongVideoBench, and VideoMME with TTFT, throughput and FLOPs metrics.
takeaways: Early compression in vision encoder significantly reduces TTFT
Decoupled selection strategy preserves spatial distribution better than top-K
weaknesses: Method relies on frame similarity thresholds which may not generalize
Sink token analysis could be more deeply explored
relevance_reason: 视频理解效率优化，与可靠性主线无直接交点
